newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Kuoni expects double-digit growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Kuoni expects double-digit growth in 1997.

text.p: Swiss travel group and tour operator Kuoni Reisen Holding AG said first quarter 1997 results were above expectations, leading it to expect double-digit growth in revenues for the entire year.
It thus expects a double-digit increase in revenues for the current year, Kuoni said in a statement released at an annual news briefing.

It said that if exchange rates, on a yearly average, remain at roughly the same levels, based on results of the first quarter the company expected an increase in the EBIT (Earnings Before Interest and Tax) of 20 percent or more.
"Depending on developments on securities exchanges, the concern profit should also improve in line with this," it said.

It also cautioned that alongside uncertainty factors tied to currencies and securities markets, as well as short-term bookings, Kuoni has 50 percent of its fixed costs in the first half, but realises only 10 to 20 percent of its operating earnings in that period.
The majority of operating results are seen in the revenue-intensive summer and autumn vacation period, which falls in the second half.
"These factors make a prognosis after the first quarter difficult," Kuoni said. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
